Devotees mark first Monday of Shravan month with temple visits and art

On the first Monday of the Shravan month in 2026, devotees visited Shiva temples across Jammu. In Puri, sand artist Sudarsan Pattnaik created a sand sculpture of Lord Shiva on the beach. Meanwhile, priests at Mahakaleshwar offered a dry fruit garland to Lord Shiva.
